PresenterIntent: Gather object facts, type descriptors, and available actions into a readable inspection structure.
RecognizerIntent: Delegate nested action and object reference interactions back into typed action requests.
LoweringRationale: The thesis emphasizes that object types and interface state should be inspectable. When Interaction IR says a subject supports inspection, PBUI should expose a structured presentation that can show object descriptors, projections, compatible actions, and provenance.
